profile.name: Sumanth Richie
profile.tagline: I design brands, build worlds and code them into the web.
profile.day: Head of Marketing at CapQ, Hyderabad

islands.title: Worlds
islands.line: Places I build whole, then light for one hour of the day.

islands.title: Machines
islands.line: Cars and machines I model to the bolt, then put on the web.

islands.title: Monuments
islands.line: Stone, studios and estates: objects that hold still and get looked at.

islands.title: Brands
islands.line: Brands are buildings. You climb them one floor at a time.

works.title: Hyperion GEN.2
works.line: A hypercar I designed and modelled from scratch, with a live 3D site.
works.brief: I wanted Hyperion to feel like a real car, so it has 20 rigged assemblies with working hinges, doors that swing up 100° and a 22-part V8. I designed the logo and carried it onto the tyres, brakes, cabin labels and dashboard screen. On the site you sweep a light over the car, spin it 360°, take it apart, and end on a meadow of 72,000 moving blades of grass.

works.title: Hyperion: Case Study
works.line: A long-read engineering report on how Hyperion was made, with a UX review of version one.
works.brief: One easy reading column, notes in the margin and numbered figures: 20 rigged assemblies, 292 meshes, a 22-part twin-turbo V8. It ends with five problems I found in my first version, from a slow 56 MB first load to contact links that did not work, and how I fixed each one.

works.title: Alpine F1 Study
works.line: My own F1 car in Alpine livery: 23 rigged assemblies, a wind tunnel and an exploded view.
works.brief: I set the car up in Blender as 23 rigged assemblies with steering and DRS hinges, baked the livery into 4K textures, designed Pirelli P Zero sidewalls and modelled a 1.6 L V6 hybrid power unit in 21 labelled parts. On the site smoke flows over the car in a wind tunnel, it comes apart in an exploded view, and the night ends in a pit lane.

works.title: Coachwork
works.line: A car magazine you read by scrolling: five issues, five cars in real-time 3D.
works.brief: Ferrari 812 Superfast, Koenigsegg Agera, Bugatti Chiron, Koenigsegg One:1 and Mercedes-AMG Project One, each painted, lit and set up in Blender. Press start on the rev counter and the engine fires with a sound I designed from scratch, with no recordings. Turn on the headlights, pick new rims, and drive a rolling road until the brakes glow.

works.title: Vanta Flightworks
works.line: A flight-helmet maker's site: the helmet turns to a new side for every section.
works.brief: A worn pilot's helmet hangs in front of the text and turns as you scroll, with a live heading, pitch and range readout that follows it. Every section and every phone layout has its own camera view.

works.title: Parian Atelier
works.line: A stone-carving studio in Athens: the marble head turns, then gold runs through the stone.
works.brief: A marble head sits in front of the text and turns as you scroll. At the very end the page goes dark, the eyes light up and gold runs through the stone. I wrote the marble, vein and gold shaders myself.

works.title: Halden Portrait Studio
works.line: A wet-plate portrait studio: you walk all the way round an antique field camera.
works.brief: An antique field camera stands in front of the text, and as you scroll you circle it: the studio name, the sitting, the lens, the ground glass, the process and the prices. Every section, and every phone layout, has its own camera view.

works.title: Altair Estates
works.line: A cliff estate you drive through: 808 trees, 2,141 lamps, 52 cameras.
works.brief: I drew the plans first: a gate, a maple avenue between a lake and a lavender field, a glass-block bridge, a gallery street, a palm canal and a house cut into a sea cliff. The site arrives as a pencil drawing and turns into the white model, then the real render develops over it as you drive.

works.title: Digital Sculpting
works.line: A human hand in ZBrush and a hard-surface gun, as clay renders.

works.title: Pendulum Clock
works.line: An octagonal wall clock with Roman numerals and a gold pendulum, wireframe to render.

works.title: Fire Extinguisher
works.line: Worn red paint, a scuffed caution label and a weathered hose, textured in Substance.

works.title: Modelling, Lighting, Texturing
works.line: Interior and product pieces, UV-mapped, textured and lit for final renders.

works.title: The Ring Gate
works.line: A 156-metre stone ring in the sea and the drowned city below it, as a scrolling art book.
works.brief: Kaalavalaya is a carved stone ring with a door that shows you what you want most and takes your shadow in return. Tirthavel is the drowned city climbing toward it. I designed the world, wrote its story, modelled it in Blender, rendered it in Unreal and built the book on the real gate mesh. One day passes over the Ring while you read.

works.title: The Flooded Rotunda
works.line: Twelve flooded arches and a marble keeper who turns to face you as the world loads.
works.brief: A drowned Romanesque ring of twelve bays, 7.9 million triangles of unique geometry plus 1.56 billion instanced through Nanite. The place has one rule: she turns to face whoever comes in. While the world downloads she is the loading screen, drawn in chalk, looking for you.

works.title: The Overgrown Archive
works.line: A portfolio you walk: a neon forest at night that ends at the sea at sunrise.
works.brief: Every section of a portfolio became a stop on a walk: monoliths for the worlds, stone lanterns for the method, a rack of CRTs for the clients, a flooded cave, a baroque hall, the sea for contact. Every asset comes from a script.

works.title: The Castle on the Crag
works.line: Forty-five towers on two granite crags above a Highland loch, as one 3D world.
works.brief: A viaduct, the boathouse stairs, a stadium and 644,000 trees, moss cushions and boulders. I modelled 120 meshes myself, planned 17 cameras and lit the world five ways: night, day, sunset, dusk and mist.

works.title: Koi Pond
works.line: A garden pond where the water is the light source, in summer and in autumn.
works.brief: The rule for this one: no light from above. Everything is lit from inside the water, so the caustics run the wrong way up the rocks and the leaves get their colour from below.

works.title: Fudō Myō-ō
works.line: A ruined temple around the immovable one: a ficus through the roof, rain around the statue.
works.brief: A ficus has broken through the roof, rain has pooled around the moss-covered statue, and plants have followed the water. Built around a single practical light: everything else is either reflecting that candle or hiding from it.

works.title: Rōman no Yoake
works.line: A pagoda at first light, lit again for pink hour, a crescent moon, a full moon and an eclipse.
works.brief: The hour before anything is awake. I wanted the fog to do the modelling: the pagoda barely earns its silhouette and the only hard edge in the frame is the sun clearing the ridge. Roughly four hundred rejected sun angles.

works.title: Caves
works.line: One walk from daylight to a red chamber where flowers grow under a crack of sky.

works.title: GC Burger
works.line: One campaign system, five locations, all in one bold red layout.
works.brief: A Canadian halal burger chain: grand openings, happy hours, Ramadan, student deals and buy-one-get-one offers across five stores. One layout that every store could run without me.

works.title: KERB
works.line: A motorsport coffee roaster: every cup is a lap, every blend a corner.
works.brief: Blends are named after the corners of a fictional circuit: Hairpin espresso 01, Apex house blend 07, Chicane decaf 12, Slipstream cold brew. The wordmark is sheared to 12° over a ten-block kerb strip, and that angle drives the badge, the livery and every graphic. Every bag carries a lap sheet with lot, drop temperature and a roast trace coloured by sector.

works.title: Deccan Night Run
works.line: A city night run where the arches keep time: arch, minaret, lamp.
works.brief: At midnight the old city slows down to a sequence of arches. Deccan Night Run turns that rhythm into an event with no podium and no rush: a logo built from arch, minaret and lamp, a sodium-on-midnight palette, race kits, route wayfinding and a pocket app.

works.title: Lotus Constructions
works.line: A Hyderabad builder's brand and site: a house rises from bare ground as you scroll.
works.brief: Footing, frame, walls, glass. At the end the camera pulls back over a street of eleven real Lotus projects I modelled in 3D, each with a name tag. No client names, plots or working drawings go on the page.

works.title: REM
works.line: After-hours food and dreamwear, drawn from one hypnogram. Open 19:00 to 04:00.
works.brief: Over a lifetime you spend about six years dreaming and remember almost none of it. REM is where that time goes. The whole system comes from the sleep hypnogram: five stage rows joined only by right-angle steps. Dark until dreaming: four neutrals carry 92% of every surface, and Lucid pink appears only where something is dreaming.

works.title: CapQ
works.line: Brand and pre-launch site for a Hyderabad business-finance advisory.
works.brief: Right Capital. Structured Right. WhatsApp, phone and an enquiry form sit within the first two screens, so the page was taking enquiries before launch. I run the brand end to end: identity, collateral, expos and MSME outreach.
works.note: Also where I work: Head of Marketing.

works.title: Mitti
works.line: Skincare made like pottery: rituals from the earth.
works.brief: A palette mixed from the ingredients themselves: fired clay, ground sandalwood, fresh haldi. Devanagari and Latin share one quiet voice, the jars are thrown like pots, and the shop is a clay niche. Rituals from the earth.

works.title: Maruneta
works.line: Colour that comes back: recycled yarn, sorted by colour so nobody re-dyes it.
works.brief: Hyderabad's cotton and denim waste, collected, sorted by colour and respun. The mark is built on one radius and drawn with one thread; every lot has a passport.

works.title: BSNL
works.line: Signal for all of us: a rebrand concept for a network that reaches 1.4 billion.
works.brief: From sarkari connection to a network for 1.4 billion. One dot, one wave. Every script, one voice. Ultramarine, lit up, and lime on every high street.

works.title: Rujuvu
works.line: A cold-chain courier for medicine: delivered, with proof.
works.brief: Rujuvu is Telugu for proof. The parcel arrives; the proof usually does not. Every box is a witness: temperature at every handover, a seal with a number, and a storefront that shows its cold room.

works.title: Kosh
works.line: Investing that feels like a game, not a lecture. Meet Gullu.
works.brief: Kosh is Sanskrit for treasury. Tiny daily drops, a treasury that grows with you, and Gullu, a clay piggy pot with big feelings. Sunny, saturated, unserious.

works.title: LAGRANGE
works.line: Where systems hold still: a night watchman for your apps.
works.brief: Software that looks after a company's apps and websites all night and fixes small problems on its own. Named after the five points in space where things stay still: five spots, one balance, drawn on a 60° grid. Spoken at 2 a.m., read without panic.

works.title: Magma
works.line: A strawberry energy drink: flame logo, can, poster and tee.
works.brief: Ignite your heart's energy. I designed the flame logo, the can label, a 3D can modelled in Maya, the poster and a T-shirt.

works.title: S—3 · The Impossible Three
works.line: My studio mark: world, web and brand. Three things that shouldn't connect, made to hold.
works.brief: S—3 is the mark I work under: an impossible triangle whose three bars are world, web and brand. They shouldn't connect, and the job is making them hold, drawn so it looks real. The social system runs on one line, Built in the dark. Lit with intent.: chapter cards, signals, teardowns and an archive, all on a near-black grid with one acid accent.

works.title: Photon Yard
works.line: Where light gets computed: a render yard for studios.
works.brief: A shipping yard for photons. Monochrome until computed: five rows, one photon path, and the spectrum only where light has been rendered. Raw in, light out.

works.title: Three Houses
works.line: AEVUM, VOLTA® and VESPERA: three concept brands, three moods, three sites.

works.title: Midea Canada
works.line: Social, retail and seasonal ads for Midea, Eureka, Comfee and Home Depot.

works.title: Investohome
works.line: Luxury real estate ads for Miami and Puerto Rico: one place, one claim, three proofs.

works.title: Brand Systems
works.line: TCP, VS Design Studio, Lakshmi Bakers and nxtwave.

works.title: Shelf & Table
works.line: Retail-display stories for KD Displays and an appetite-first calendar for Amaya.

works.title: Front Doors
works.line: My last portfolio: one 3D door that opens onto thirteen websites.

works.line: Photo manipulation and retouching.
